name: hibayes
description: Claude Code skills for HiBayES, the hierarchical Bayesian modelling framework for AI evaluation statistics.

plugins.name: hibayes-skills
plugins.description: Skills for analysing AI-evaluation data with HiBayES: installing and running the five-stage pipeline (load, process, model, check, communicate), the YAML config and component registries, and the Bayesian workflow — estimand, pooling choice, priors, diagnostics, model comparison, reporting — with a plain-language concepts reference for explaining results.
